tasks.label: lint
tasks.command: ruff check .

tasks.label: format
tasks.command: ruff format .

tasks.label: pytest-host
tasks.command: pytest -q --maxfail=1 --disable-warnings --cov --cov-report=term-missing

tasks.label: host-sim-smoke
tasks.detail: Run main.py with host shims for a few seconds to verify startup
tasks.command: $errFile = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'hostsim.err'; $p = Start-Process python -ArgumentList 'main.py' -PassThru -NoNewWindow -RedirectStandardError $errFile; Start-Sleep -Seconds 5; if ($p.HasExited) { Get-Content $errFile -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Error 'host-sim exited early'; exit 1 } else { Stop-Process -Id $p.Id -Force; Write-Host 'host-sim smoke OK' }

tasks.label: check
tasks.detail: Run lint, tests, then host-sim smoke test — full quality gate

tasks.label: ai-verify
tasks.detail: Agent verification gate: lint + tests with coverage + host-sim smoke (verbose output for agent parsing)
tasks.command: ruff check .; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; python -m pytest tests/ -v --tb=short --cov=lib --cov=config --cov-fail-under=88 --cov-report=term-missing; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit 1 }; $proc = Start-Process python -ArgumentList 'main.py' -PassThru -NoNewWindow; Start-Sleep 5; if ($proc.HasExited) { Write-Error 'Host-sim exited early'; exit 1 } else { Stop-Process $proc; Write-Host 'Host-sim smoke: OK' }

tasks.label: build-mpy
tasks.command: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (-not (Get-Command mpy-cross -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Error 'mpy-cross not found in PATH. Install mpy-cross and retry.'; exit 1 }; $buildRoot = 'build'; $buildLib = Join-Path $buildRoot 'lib'; if (Test-Path $buildRoot) { Remove-Item $buildRoot -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $buildLib -Force | Out-Null; Copy-Item main.py (Join-Path $buildRoot 'main.py') -Force; & mpy-cross config.py -o (Join-Path $buildRoot 'config.mpy'); if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error 'Failed compiling config.py'; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $libSources = Get-ChildItem lib -File -Filter *.py | Where-Object { $_.Name -ne '__init__.py' }; if (-not $libSources) { Write-Error 'No runtime Python modules found under lib/ to compile.'; exit 1 }; foreach ($src in $libSources) { $outFile = Join-Path $buildLib ($src.BaseName + '.mpy'); & mpy-cross $src.FullName -o $outFile; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Error ('Failed compiling ' + $src.Name); exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; Write-Host ('build-mpy complete: config.py and ' + $libSources.Count + ' lib modules compiled to ' + $buildRoot)

tasks.label: flash-mpremote
tasks.detail: Compile runtime artifacts, then flash only main.py, config.py, and lib/ (auto-toggles MicroPico)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; if (-not (Test-Path 'build/main.py') -or -not (Test-Path 'build/config.mpy') -or -not (Test-Path 'build/lib')) { Write-Error 'Missing build artifacts. Run build-mpy first.'; Connect-MicroPico; exit 1 }; $libArtifacts = Get-ChildItem build/lib -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.mpy', '.py' }; if (-not $libArtifacts) { Write-Error 'No lib artifacts in build/lib to flash.'; Connect-MicroPico; exit 1 }; mpremote fs mkdir /lib *> $null; mpremote fs rm /config.py *> $null; $libCopy = ($libArtifacts | ForEach-Object { '+ fs cp build/lib/' + $_.Name + ' :/lib/' + $_.Name }) -join ' '; Invoke-Expression ('mpremote soft-reset + fs cp build/main.py :main.py + fs cp build/config.mpy :config.mpy ' + $libCopy); $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Connect-MicroPico; exit $rc

tasks.label: flash-mpremote-nocheck
tasks.detail: Compile runtime artifacts, then flash only main.py, config.py, and lib/ (auto-toggles MicroPico)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; if (-not (Test-Path 'build/main.py') -or -not (Test-Path 'build/config.mpy') -or -not (Test-Path 'build/lib')) { Write-Error 'Missing build artifacts. Run build-mpy first.'; Connect-MicroPico; exit 1 }; $libArtifacts = Get-ChildItem build/lib -File | Where-Object { $_.Extension -in '.mpy', '.py' }; if (-not $libArtifacts) { Write-Error 'No lib artifacts in build/lib to flash.'; Connect-MicroPico; exit 1 }; mpremote fs mkdir /lib *> $null; mpremote fs rm /config.py *> $null; $libCopy = ($libArtifacts | ForEach-Object { '+ fs cp build/lib/' + $_.Name + ' :/lib/' + $_.Name }) -join ' '; Invoke-Expression ('mpremote soft-reset + fs cp build/main.py :main.py + fs cp build/config.mpy :config.mpy ' + $libCopy); $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Connect-MicroPico; exit $rc

tasks.label: clean-device
tasks.detail: Removes all flashed files and directories from Pico flash (preserves /sd mount; fails silently on missing entries; auto-toggles MicroPico)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; try { Write-Host 'clean-device: scanning Pico root...'; $listing = & mpremote fs ls / 2>$null; $entries = @(); foreach ($line in $listing) { $t = $line.Trim(); if (-not $t -or $t.StartsWith('ls ')) { continue }; $parts = $t -split '\s+', 2; if ($parts.Count -lt 2) { continue }; $name = $parts[1]; if ($name -eq 'sd/' -or $name -eq 'sd') { Write-Host ('  skip: ' + $name + ' (preserved SD mount)'); continue }; $entries += $name }; if (-not $entries) { Write-Host 'clean-device: nothing to remove (flash already empty)' } else { Write-Host ('clean-device: ' + $entries.Count + ' entr' + $(if ($entries.Count -eq 1) {'y'} else {'ies'}) + ' to remove'); $removed = 0; $failed = 0; foreach ($name in $entries) { $isDir = $name.EndsWith('/'); $target = ':/' + $name.TrimEnd('/'); $kind = if ($isDir) { 'dir ' } else { 'file' }; Write-Host ('  removing ' + $kind + ' ' + $name); if ($isDir) { & mpremote fs rm -r $target 2>$null | Out-Null } else { & mpremote fs rm $target 2>$null | Out-Null }; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { $removed++; Write-Host '    ok' } else { $failed++; Write-Host '    failed' } }; Write-Host ('clean-device: done - removed ' + $removed + ', failed ' + $failed) } } finally { Connect-MicroPico }; exit 0

tasks.label: clean-and-flash
tasks.detail: Wipe all files from Pico then flash everything fresh (no quality checks; auto-toggles MicroPico)

tasks.label: repl
tasks.detail: Interactive MicroPython REPL on connected Pico (auto-toggles MicroPico; reconnects on exit)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; mpremote repl; Connect-MicroPico

tasks.label: serial-monitor
tasks.detail: Passive serial output from connected Pico (auto-toggles MicroPico; reconnects on exit)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; mpremote repl --escape-non-printable; Connect-MicroPico

tasks.label: run-on-device
tasks.detail: Execute main.py on Pico without flashing (auto-toggles MicroPico)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; mpremote run main.py; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Connect-MicroPico; exit $rc

tasks.label: run-on-device (current file)
tasks.detail: Execute the currently open file on Pico (auto-toggles MicroPico)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; mpremote run ${file}; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Connect-MicroPico; exit $rc

tasks.label: mount-and-run
tasks.detail: Mount workspace on Pico VFS and run main.py — edits visible instantly (auto-toggles MicroPico; reconnects on exit)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; mpremote mount . run main.py; Connect-MicroPico

tasks.label: pull-logs
tasks.detail: Copy SD logs from Pico to local sd/ folder (auto-toggles MicroPico)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; mpremote fs cp -r :/sd/ sd/; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Connect-MicroPico; exit $rc

tasks.label: list-device-files
tasks.detail: List files on Pico flash and SD card (auto-toggles MicroPico)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; mpremote fs ls / + fs ls /sd/; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Connect-MicroPico; exit $rc

tasks.label: host-sim
tasks.detail: Run main.py with host shims on CPython
tasks.command: python main.py

tasks.label: watch-lint
tasks.detail: Auto-lint on every file save
tasks.command: ruff check --watch .

tasks.label: watch-test
tasks.detail: Re-run tests on file changes (requires ptw)
tasks.command: ptw -- -q --maxfail=1 --disable-warnings

tasks.label: build-update-payload
tasks.detail: Build SD-update payload (manifest.json + main/config/lib) into build/update_payload/
tasks.command: python tools/build_update_payload.py

tasks.label: deploy-update-to-sdcard
tasks.detail: Compile, build SD-update payload (config + lib compiled to .mpy), and copy to G:\ota\pending (auto-confirms overwrite)
tasks.command: python tools/build_update_payload.py --compiled --copy-to G:/ota/pending --no-confirm

tasks.label: deploy-update-to-sdcard-nocheck
tasks.detail: Compile, build SD-update payload (config + lib compiled to .mpy), and copy to G:\ota\pending without running tests first
tasks.command: python tools/build_update_payload.py --compiled --copy-to G:/ota/pending --no-confirm

tasks.label: hw-probe
tasks.detail: Run hardware probe suite on connected Pico — writes JSON to SD (auto-toggles MicroPico)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; mpremote run hw_probe.py; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Connect-MicroPico; exit $rc

tasks.label: pull-probe
tasks.detail: Copy probe JSON results from Pico SD card to probe_results/ (auto-toggles MicroPico)
tasks.command: . .vscode\micropico-port.ps1; Disconnect-MicroPico; mpremote fs cp :/sd/hw_probe_*.json probe_results/; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Connect-MicroPico; exit $rc
